messages:
maria: Quick sync: EdgeBox (HW partner) will report per-minute usage but often uploads gzipped batches up to 48h late. We need: device_id->customer mapping, SKU names, HMAC verification, dedupe, and a reconciliation playbook. Any blockers?

sarah: We can accept late batches. Must enforce idempotency on batch_id/event_id and clear response codes (401 for bad sig, 400 malformed, 200 ignored for dups). Who owns SKU canonicalization?

raj: Partnerships will own logical SKU mapping. EdgeBox proposes skus: edge_minutes_v3 (consumption) and edge_seat_license (entitlement). Minimal batch example: {batch_id:uuid, org_id:org-123, device_id:eb-01, events:[{event_id:e1, device_ts:2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00, seconds:120}], seat_count:2, signature:hmac}

oliver: Ops requirements: verify HMAC (shared secret), dedupe TTL prod=30d/staging=14d, log metrics for ingestion rate and signature failures. Late batches should mark affected UTC invoice windows "dirty" and trigger re-aggregate job.

emily: Two policy items: (1) attribution when plan changes mid-window: attribute by event time and prorate if plan boundary crosses event timestamp. (2) timezone handling: convert device_ts to UTC at ingest and persist raw seconds for audit. Billing rounds up to nearest whole minute for charges.

sarah: I'll update the API contract to accept optional plan_id and plan_effective_ts to make reconciliation deterministic. Acceptance tests: duplicate batch ignored, signature fails 401, late batch re-aggregates window and creates audit diff.

raj: I'll coordinate secret exchange with EdgeBox and schedule onboarding Tue 10am PT. @billing-bot can you provision a staging org/key?

billing-bot: Provisioned staging org edgebox-sbx-002 and key sbx-edge-XX. Sandbox plan edgebox-staging-30d created. :white_check_mark:

maria: Excellent. Action items: sarah PR for spec+tests, raj secret exchange+onboard, oliver add reconciliation alert (variance threshold and console alert), emily write runbook for late-batch reprocessing. We'll run verification after EdgeBox submits 3 sample batches. :thumbsup:
